title: Home's 'Cards · N learnt' counts every schedule in state.srs: quiz questions and the cards the study clean-up removed — 290 on the copy, 212 real flashcards
detail: Copy account, Home's hours card: '0 due Cards · 290 learnt'. Of the 290 schedules with reps>0, 212 are flashcards that exist (KOS.srs.allCards(), CS/Maths/Code), 56 are cards the clean-up removed (keys with no card: 4.5.1.1-4.5.1.3, 4.5.2.1, S1.1, S2.1 and two more) and 22 are Code quiz questions (q:code:1.1-1.5). So the label 'Cards … learnt' overstates by 78 (37%), and the number grows with every quiz answered. Measured twice (eval of KOS.store.state.srs against allCards and the rendered home.fact). The orphan part is noted in DI-30; the question part is new.
rootCause: js/modules/home.js:1050 — learnt counts Object.keys(store.state.srs) with reps>0 and never asks KOS.questions.isKey or whether the card still exists (srs keys hold q:/e:/x: question schedules since 5.19).
evidence: eval {learntAll:290, learntRealCards:212, orphan:56, learntQ:22, homeFact:'0 due Cards · 290 learnt'}; js/modules/home.js:1050
fix: Count over KOS.srs.allCards() (KOS.srs.peek(c.key).reps>0), or at least skip KOS.questions.isKey(k); the same set Card stats uses.
